title: Heimdall agent event
description: One step an agent reports about itself (docs/agent-events.md). Send one object per line to BENCH_EVENTS_URL (POST, JSON lines, a JSON array or one object), append one per line to BENCH_EVENTS_FILE, or print one per stdout line after the prefix '@@heimdall-event '. Every field is the agent's own word: the bench caps, redacts and shows it as agent-reported evidence, which never raises a trusted metric or decides an outcome.

type.description: What kind of step this is. An unknown value is kept as custom.

id.description: The agent's id for this event, unique within the run. Other events name it in parent_id.

parent_id.description: id of the enclosing event (a subagent_start, a plan), for nesting.

name.description: Tool name, subagent name, handoff target, memory key or a short label.

tool_call_id.description: The model's tool call id, when the step answers one; links the report to the gateway's record.

input.description: Input of the step (tool arguments, query). Any JSON; kept as text up to 2 KiB.

output.description: Output of the step (tool result, plan text). Any JSON; kept as text up to 2 KiB.

start_time.description: When the step started: an RFC 3339 string or Unix milliseconds. Missing means the time it was received.

end_time.description: When the step ended: an RFC 3339 string or Unix milliseconds.

attributes.description: Extra key-value pairs; values are strings, numbers or booleans. At most 32 are kept.
